body.purpose: Default body and UI text. Prose caps at 65 to 75ch.

label.purpose: Form labels, button text, nav items.

mono.purpose: Literal machine values only: addresses, domains, code, MJML.

shadows.name: raise
shadows.purpose: Gentle hover lift on interactive cards and rows. Absent at rest.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modals and sheets, paired with a scrim.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard easing. No bounce, no elastic. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action per context. Signal Indigo fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 14px; background:oklch(54% 0.12 270); color:oklch(99% 0.01 270); border:none; border-radius:6px; font:500 0.8125rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(48% 0.13 270); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:oklch(43% 0.13 270); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(54% 0.12 270 / 0.4); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The default for most actions. Bordered, neutral fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 14px; background:oklch(99.6% 0.003 270); color:oklch(38% 0.015 270); border:1px solid oklch(88% 0.008 270); border-radius:6px; font:500 0.8125rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:oklch(96.5% 0.005 270); border-color:oklch(80% 0.01 270); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(54% 0.12 270 / 0.4); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Always carries a visible label above it.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; max-width:320px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; background:oklch(99.6% 0.003 270); color:oklch(38% 0.015 270); border:1px solid oklch(88% 0.008 270); border-radius:6px; font:400 0.9375rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:oklch(68% 0.01 270); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:oklch(54% 0.12 270); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px oklch(54% 0.12 270 / 0.35); }

components.name: Status Badge (Success)
components.description: Canonical state pattern: subtle tint, solid foreground, always a leading icon (color is never the only signal).
components.html: Valid MJML
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:2px 8px; background:oklch(95% 0.03 150); color:oklch(40% 0.09 150); border-radius:9999px; font:600 0.6875rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: Side-nav item, active state. Conveyed by fill and ink weight plus an accent dot, never a left side stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:34px; padding:0 12px; background:oklch(95% 0.03 270); color:oklch(25% 0.02 270); border-radius:6px; font:500 0.8125rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.01em; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:9999px; background:oklch(54% 0.12 270); }

components.name: Authorization Context Bar
components.description: Signature component. A persistent, low-emphasis strip in the app shell stating the authorized-simulation context. Info color only, never danger or warning.
components.html: Authorized simulationClientCo / M365 engagement
components.css: .ds-authbar { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:5px 12px; background:oklch(95% 0.03 245); color:oklch(44% 0.09 245); border-radius:6px; font:600 0.6875rem/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-authbar-scope { color:oklch(60% 0.10 245); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.02em; text-transform:none; }

narrative.overview: PhishForge is a precision instrument for a sensitive job. The interface behaves like a well calibrated tool in a professional's hands: quiet, exact, and completely trustworthy. Surfaces are tinted near neutrals on a faint indigo axis, space is generous and rhythmic, and a single disciplined indigo accent does all the pointing. The lineage is Linear's structural precision and Stripe's documentation grade clarity, dialed calm. It explicitly rejects the costumes of its category: not hacker or dark web, not consumer marketing, not the reflex navy-and-gold enterprise-security template. Because PhishForge walks an ethical line, the design states which side it is on: the authorization context is a standing, first-class element of the app shell, not fine print.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted neutrals on a faint indigo axis (hue 270), never pure black or white.
One restrained accent (Signal Indigo), reserved for action, selection, and state.
Fixed rem type scale, single sans family, with a mono for addresses and code.
Flat by default; depth is a response to state, not decoration.
Light and dark are the same roles remapped, not two separate designs.
Status is never carried by color alone.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo appears on at most ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes it mean act here or this is selected. If two things on a screen compete for the accent, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff, ever. Every neutral carries hue 270 at chroma 0.003 to 0.02. Pure greys are forbidden; they read cold and break cohesion.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for literal machine values (email addresses, domains, code, MJML). Never for prose, labels, or decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state (hover lift) or because the element overlays the page (menu, popover, modal).

rules.name: The Two Signal Rule
rules.body: Status is conveyed by color plus an icon or label together, so meaning survives color-blind viewing. Color is never the only signal.

dos: Do tint every neutral toward hue 270 at chroma 0.003 to 0.02. Use surface-* and ink-* tokens, never raw greys.
Do keep Signal Indigo to at most ~10% of any screen. Reserve it for action, selection, focus, and live state.
Do convey status with color plus an icon or label together, so meaning survives color-blind viewing.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; add the Raise shadow only on hover and the Overlay/Dialog shadows only for floating elements.
Do use one button vocabulary everywhere. The same action looks identical on every screen.
Do give every interactive control a visible focus-visible ring and full keyboard operability (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Do keep the Authorization Context Bar present on every authenticated screen.
Do use Mono only for literal machine values (addresses, domains, code, MJML).
donts: Don't use any hacker or dark-web aesthetic: no neon on black, no terminal green, no skull or hood iconography.
Don't use consumer-marketing flashiness: no gradient heroes, no oversized emotive imagery, no mascots, no confetti, no growth-hacky urgency.
Don't fall back on the navy-and-gold enterprise-security cliche or stock shield-and-lock decoration.
Don't use a colored side stripe (border-left/border-right greater than 1px) on cards, list items, nav, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism by default, the big-number hero-metric template, or endless identical icon-heading-text card grids.
Don't reach for a modal first. Exhaust inline and progressive disclosure before a dialog.
Don't use #000 or #fff, decorative motion that does not convey state, or display type in labels, buttons, or data.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy. Use commas, colons, periods, or parentheses.
